summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a routine at-the-market (ATM) equity offering. The company had previously sold the full $14.2 million under a prior prospectus supplement and has now filed a new supplement to sell up to $75 million in common stock through Cantor Fitzgerald as sales agent. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, or restructuring is involved. The filing simply updates the available offering amount under an existing sales agreement. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
